status: SOURCE FEASIBILITY REVIEW; APPLICATION EDITOR NOT REPLACED

sourceSemantics.references: Atomic inline occurrence with stable identity; detect projection uses one U+FFFC, clipboard/persistence expands owner canonical mention, send serializes owner reference; plain string substitution is insufficient.
sourceSemantics.commands: Claim belongs only to leading seat; moving before it releases to literal token. First backward/forward deletion adjacent selects the command chip without moving logical selection, second removes; ordinary references delete in one step.
sourceSemantics.history: Reference occurrences and command claim restore with undo, paste/completion have explicit undo boundaries; committed clear cuts history.
sourceSemantics.copyPaste: Reference clipboard is canonical mention, not the label and not U+FFFC. Pasted external U+FFFC is removed. File drill remains literal open text; settled file/session candidates become atomic references.
sourceSemantics.selection: Display/detect/clipboard/model coordinates differ; source JS uses UTF16. Native rune/UTF8/UTF16 conversions must be explicit.

publicMyGoCapabilities.textArea: TextRanges supports only color/weight; cannot substitute glyph/object width or atomic rich display while keeping native text geometry.
publicMyGoCapabilities.richtext: Public Document+Attachment{Draw,Data} supports inline U+FFFC objects, shaped layout, one-unit deletion, caret/selection and undo-restored attachment metadata. ContentHeight/CaretRect available.
richtextGaps: Default PlainText deletes all U+FFFC; app must override keyboard and Edit-menu copy/cut/paste to use canonical projection

Element.Composing reads stock TextArea editor only; richtext owns a separate private TextInputClient. Its public options expose OnKey without actual marked-state getter. CmdEnter can reach OnKey during composition. ObserveInput covers editEvent composition route but direct native TextInputClient callbacks remain unobservable through this public adapter.
Rich document metadata serialization loses app Data/Draw; restoring drafts must explicitly rebuild occurrences
publicMyGoCapabilities.fullNativeCustom: Public ui.TextInputClient + ShapeRichText provide primitives for a new app-owned rich editor with complete marked-state ownership, but rebuilding navigation, selection, history and accessibility is a larger project.
publicMyGoCapabilities.nativeSurface: Public ui.NativeView accepts PlatformView.NativeView()uintptr and native.View exposes the same method. A narrow app-owned NSTextView input surface can therefore be hosted without modifying frozen MyGo or using a resident WK composer.

findings: Real richtext attachment deletes atomically; CmdZ restores exact metadata pointer; default plain clipboard omits canonical mention
Real richtext marked text + CmdEnter reaches OnKey while Element.Composing is false. This is a capability diagnostic, not a proposal to ship this send guard.

recommendedSlice.surface: Narrow AppKit NSTextView embedded in existing native composer via ui.NativeView; existing native toolbar/queue/image rail stay native and all remote RPCs stay Go helper.
recommendedSlice.gate: First local-only proof: inline attachment caret hit-testing, atomic deletion/undo, actual hasMarkedText CmdEnter suppression, clipboard canonical projection, finite nativeview bounds/lifecycle. If these fail, do not replace current GUI7 editor.
recommendedSlice.implementation: Structured native draft document owns text/reference/command occurrences; Go mirrors canonical payload and maps detect caret for existing scoped completion services. Preserve original Host mention bytes and existing send receipts/attachments, with all writes fixture only.
cut: File/session atomic reference chips with original icon/label/max240/ellipsis
Selection, copy/cut/paste, Unicode/IME, arrow/delete/undo/redo and session-switch restoration
Permission command chip leading seat/two-step delete and existing parameter branch; remaining claim types explicitly incomplete
recommendedSlice.eta: 15min native API proof, then45–60min vertical slice if proof succeeds; full original command/quote editor parity is outside this first cut.

applicationEditsThisReview: composer_state.go: composerPreset.Description optional DTO field requested by native header owner only; no editor replacement yet
